Cook – Lunch Restaurant

Café Lindgården serves 300 lunch guests a day in central Uppsala. We cook everything from scratch with local produce.

You will prepare hot dishes, salads and soups for our daily lunch menu. You will also bake bread, keep the kitchen clean and follow our food safety routines.

Requirements
- Completed vocational training as a cook, or equivalent experience
- At least two years of experience in a restaurant kitchen
- Knowledge of food hygiene and allergies

We offer
- Daytime hours, Monday to Friday, with no evenings
- Free lunch and a staff discount
